entries.description: Move up to your full Basic Move in meters. May face any direction.
Reload a weapon, draw an item, drink a vial, or prepare equipment.
Add weapon's ACC to your next ranged Attack. +1 per additional Aim (max ACC+2). Canceled by any Active Defense or injury.
If Stunned: -4 to Active Defense. Otherwise rest to recover FP.
Channel powers or skills requiring focus. Roll Will-3 if injured or defending.
Define a trigger; if it occurs, perform your chosen maneuver immediately.
Make one melee or ranged attack. Step 1 meter before or after.
Pay 2 FP. +4 to hit melee, +1 to hit ranged. Cannot defend next turn.
Pay 2 FP. +2 to damage. Cannot defend next turn.
Pay 2 FP. Two separate attacks (roll twice). Cannot defend next turn.
Move full distance, then attack. -4 to hit. Cannot defend next turn.
Pay 2 FP. +2 to one active defense until next turn. Cannot attack.
Pay 2 FP. Use two different defenses vs. one attack. Cannot attack.

Roll a Quick Contest of your Melee skill vs. opponent's Melee, Cloak, Shield, or DX. If you succeed (or succeed by more), subtract your margin of success/victory from their active defense on your next Attack, All-Out Attack, or Move and Attack this turn.
